title: Beware it doesn't keep the heat!
text: Beware it doesn't keep the heat!. I was looking for a larger capacity coffee cup for work. While I did find it with this one, sadly it doesn't stay hot (or warm) for very long. The lid doesn't close properly either. The flip lid doesn't click so I've spilled coffee on a few different occasions. I won't be buying again.

product_metadata.title: Bubba Classic Insulated Travel Mug, 24 oz, RealTree Black
features: Designed to work with hot or cold beverages
Double wall insulation helps keep drinks hot or cold for hours and reduces condensation
Real tree Design adds personality and blends in perfectly with any gear
Convenient flip top lid for easy drinking
description: The bubba 24 ounce Classic Insulated Tumbler featuring the Real tree(R) design is the perfect tumbler for any sportsman or sportswoman! This tumbler is made of double wall foam insulation to help keep your drinks hot or cold for hours. It's also designed to fit most car cup holders, so it's easy to take on-the-go. This tumbler has easy flip lid that locks into place while drinking or when closed. It's the perfect size to get you going in the morning and ready to take on the day. For added peace of mind, all bubba products have a lifetime guarantee.
